user.title: Add SOLEM BL-IP controller
user.description: Select a discovered SOLEM BL-IP Bluetooth watering controller and configure how Home Assistant should talk to it.

data_description.address: The Bluetooth address of your BL-IP. Only devices already advertising to Home Assistant appear here.
data_description.station_count: How many physical zones your model controls (1, 2, 4 or 6).
data_description.default_duration: Duration used by the station switches when you turn them on from the UI. Service calls can override this per-call.
data_description.polling_enabled: Read the controller status periodically so sensors (timer remaining, irrigating, mode) stay live. Disable for maximum battery life: the state will only update after manual commands or pressing 'Refresh Status'.
data_description.idle_poll_interval: How often to poll while the controller is idle (not watering). Longer is gentler on the battery. Default 600 = 10 minutes.
data_description.active_poll_interval: How often to poll while watering, so the timer countdown stays accurate. Shorter values drain more battery during a session.
data_description.bluetooth_timeout: Maximum time to wait for a BLE connect or notification before giving up. Increase if you reach the controller through a slow proxy.
data_description.keep_connection: Reuse the BLE session across consecutive operations instead of reconnecting every time. Recommended on; the connection closes automatically after the idle timeout below.
data_description.connection_idle_timeout: How long to keep the BLE connection open with no traffic. Short values (5-15s) save battery; longer values make back-to-back commands snappier.
data_description.enable_program_editing: When enabled, exposes select/number/text entities to edit programs from the UI. Each change triggers a BLE write to the controller. Off by default.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the controller.
error.no_devices: No SOLEM BL-IP devices were found.

init.title: SOLEM BL-IP options
init.description: Tune polling cadence and Bluetooth behavior. See the integration README for three suggested presets (battery saver / balanced / responsive).

start_station.name: Start station
start_station.description: Water a single station for the requested duration. Lets automations water each station for a different time without changing the global watering duration.

station.name: Station
station.description: Station number to activate, between 1 and the controller's station count.

start_all_stations.name: Start all stations
start_all_stations.description: Run every station sequentially for the requested duration.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Watering duration per station in minutes (1-720).

stop.name: Stop watering
stop.description: Stop any manual watering currently running on the controller.

run_program.name: Run program
run_program.description: Run one of the controller's pre-configured programs (A, B or C).

configure_program.name: Configure program
configure_program.description: Update a program slot on the controller (read-modify-write). Only the provided fields are changed; reserved bytes are preserved byte-for-byte.

program.name: Program
program.description: Program number to modify (1 = A, 2 = B, 3 = C).

frequency.name: Frequency
frequency.description: Frequency mode (daily, custom, even_days, odd_days, odd_days_excl_31, interval).

stations.name: Stations
stations.description: Per-station duration in MINUTES, as { station_number: minutes }.
